newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rubber prices steady in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Thai rubber prices steady in quiet market.

text.p: Thai nearby rubber prices were steady this week despite a drop in supply as demand was weak and Chinese buyers made only enquiries, traders said on Friday.
Although Chinese buyers had entered the market to check for prices, traders said there were no fresh orders.
Thai benchmark RSS3 for October shipment was quoted around US$1.28-1.29/kg, barely changed from last week.
The wet spell in the main southern and other growing areas this week trimmed supplies, traders said.
According to government rubber auction market sources, the volume of sheet rubber that entered the market from September 9-13 dropped by 34.75 percent from the previous week.
